commentary: With Nifty breaking intermediate moving averages on heavy institutional liquidation and breadth deteriorating to 35, the market gate is WEAK. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns that three out of four stocks track the broader tape down, rendering fresh long exposure highly vulnerable. William O'Neil's CANSLIM system mandates preserving capital until a verified follow-through day occurs. Although select individual setups exhibit constructive relative strength, progressive exposure rules require extreme selectivity, smaller position sizing, and tighter loss-cutting. In weak breadth environments, cash is an active tactical hedge while leaders build proper right hands of bases.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AARTIPHARM.technical: Trading firmly above upward-sloping 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Pattern exhibits a double-bottom base with constructive volume expansion (1.15x average) and RSI at 71, reflecting dominant relative strength despite broad market headwinds.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM-grade performance driven by 44% capacity expansion in xanthine derivatives and rapid CDMO ramp-up (+96%). EBITDA margins expanded 428 bps to 22.1% alongside a pristine balance sheet (net debt-to-equity below 0.15).
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis breaks below the 963.13 swing low. In a WEAK market gate, strictly enforce stops to avoid sudden gap risk.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating above 21-EMA and 50-SMA in a double-bottom structure with neckline resistance near 855.55. Lower wick demonstrates absorption off session lows, with MACD positive, but overhead supply persists.
ABDL.fundamental: Revenue grew 15.9% supported by premiumization and volume expansion in Prestige & Above brands, but earnings momentum decelerated to single digits (+9.7%) due to marketing investments and high raw material overhead.
ABDL.risk: Breach below 798.53 pivot invalidates pattern support. Sub-25% EPS acceleration caps the setup strictly to watchlist status.

ABGSEC.technical: Near breakout within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above key moving averages with 1.87x volume. However, as an exchange-traded fund, classical equity base mechanics do not apply.
ABGSEC.fundamental: not verified. ABGSEC is an open-ended sovereign gilt ETF tracking government securities; corporate CANSLIM metrics, revenue growth, and ROE/ROCE calculations are inapplicable.
ABGSEC.risk: Fails stock screening criteria entirely; thesis invalid for equity growth trading. Support lies at 116.48 stop level.

AIROLAM.technical: Double bottom with a three-bar pullback bounce (3-up) above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. RSI at 55 demonstrates steady recovery momentum, though volume conviction remains muted on the push toward 123.89.
AIROLAM.fundamental: not verified. The decorative laminate maker faces industry-wide input cost volatility and subdued domestic building product demand; leverage remains moderate with debt-to-equity around 1.0x.
AIROLAM.risk: A drop below 103.64 violates base structural integrity. Unverified earnings require discipline; avoid pre-empting the breakout.

AJAXENGG.technical: Constructing a double bottom above ascending 21-EMA and 50-SMA with expanding volume (1.56x) and positive MACD. Trigger at 635.63 tests upper overhead supply.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Solid market position in concrete equipment with an almost debt-free balance sheet and healthy ROCE of 23.9%, but top-line (+10.6%) and contracting net profit (-2.3%) fail CANSLIM thresholds.
AJAXENGG.risk: Violating 594.18 confirms failure of right-side base accumulation. Negative quarterly earnings growth caps setup quality strictly to Watch.

AJMERA.technical: High-volume 20-day breakout clearing resistance on 28.87x average volume. Price stands well above 21-EMA and 50-SMA, but massive volume thrust requires verification to rule out churn.
AJMERA.fundamental: Sales bookings and revenue expanded robustly (+35%) following project completions in Mumbai, but historical quarterly profit acceleration has been uneven (+14% vs -12% prior) with elevated sector leverage.
AJMERA.risk: Thesis invalid below 135.25. Without verified >=25% consecutive EPS acceleration, do not chase extended volume bursts into market weakness.
